scope: Unity MVP progression graph linking player choices to accepted commands, actual task or physics acknowledgements, observed changes, and next eligible choices

authorityBoundary.branchMeaning: A deterministic game-state transition or run-lineage branch.
authorityBoundary.causalMeaning: Do not label ordered trace edges as identified scientific causality. Reserve identified_causal_effect for a declared intervention/comparison design with assumptions, fixed comparison basis, and scoped outcomes.
authorityBoundary.currentClaim: The MVP can prove which accepted event preceded and enabled a later game choice, and can record within-model observed deltas. It cannot infer real-world emergency causal effects from that trace.

directlySupported: Event plus condition drives enabled transitions.
Run-to-completion and ordered transition selection provide deterministic state-machine semantics for a given input sequence when external nondeterminism is excluded.
Parallel regions are supported without making transition order implicit.
primarySources.useHere: Model mission and scenario progression as explicit states, events, guards, and transition priority; implement only the small subset needed by the MVP.

directlySupported: Entity, Activity, and Agent form a provenance basis.
used, wasGeneratedBy, wasInformedBy, and wasDerivedFrom form provenance and dependency chains.
primarySources.useHere: Use a small PROV-inspired vocabulary for who issued a choice, which receipt or result was used, and which projection or eligibility snapshot was generated; do not adopt RDF as a runtime requirement.

directlySupported: Causal claims require assumptions and a language for interventions or counterfactuals beyond ordinary association.
Effects of interventions are a distinct query from observed association.
primarySources.useHere: Keep process dependency, temporal order, and observed model delta separate from identified causal effect.

directlySupported: Timed-arc Petri nets model distributed computations with token age and time-constrained transitions.
TAPAAL supports simulation plus CTL, LTL, HyperLTL, and boundedness verification.
primarySources.useHere: Defer Petri nets from the runtime slice. Later project only resource/channel concurrency into a bounded offline model to check deadlock, reachability, and capacity invariants.

directlySupported: Workflow history is an ordered event sequence sufficient to recover workflow execution state.
Reset or conflict resolution can produce branching history topology.
primarySources.useHere: Adopt the event-history principle locally without installing a workflow framework: immutable run prefix, sequence-keyed events, derived current projection, and explicit branch parent.

localEvidence.finding: Stable IDs, sequence distinct from time, receipt keys, fingerprints, accepted receipts, later completion events, and semantic validation already define most event-graph identity rules.
Append-only run events, complete checkpoint requirements, explicit branch parents, and REEXECUTE_FROM_ORIGIN fallback already exist as canonical design boundaries.
AI is already constrained to consume deterministic state; timeout, invalid output, and model metadata must not mutate the run.
Operation, agency, logical-team ownership and request/revision ACK matching already provide the action-to-ack seam.
Accepted worker results advance simulation time, update task ACKs, expose physics results, and then advance agency mission state.
The worker distinguishes warn, evacuate, and medical effects, fences generations, and explicitly lacks durable checkpoint/replay.

recommendedMinimalGraph.runtimeAuthority: Deterministic C# transition evaluator over typed events and guards; no graph database or new framework.
recommendedMinimalGraph.invariant: identified_causal_effect defaults false and requires a separate comparison-design record; state_transition never upgrades it.
recommendedMinimalGraph.guardReuse: Reuse the existing TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICTED RuleExpression result. Only TRUE enables a choice; FALSE disables with reason; UNKNOWN and CONFLICTED remain visible and non-executable.

branchingRecommendation.mvpNow: Record an immutable linear event stream and render alternative eligible outgoing edges from each accepted snapshot.
branchingRecommendation.exactFork: Not supported until a complete checkpoint includes domain state, queues, leases, RNG streams, worker state or certified replay recipe.
branchingRecommendation.currentFallback: Use REEXECUTE_FROM_ORIGIN with pinned seed, inputs, model/code hashes, and recorded player choices; compare state digest and declared outcomes. Label failure to reproduce as incomparable.
branchingRecommendation.petriNetBoundary: After the event/state slice stabilizes, export channel leases, team availability, queue capacity, and return/reuse as a bounded offline net. Do not make the Petri net a second runtime authority.

preferredRoles.use: Before release, choose among enumerated graph topology or wording options and emit a proposed revision.
After deterministic validation, classify bounded questions such as missing ACK edge, unsupported causal label, or unsafe fallback. Root accepts or rejects.

runtimeProposal.allowed: Rank or explain only the deterministic engine-provided eligible choice IDs.
runtimeProposal.typedContract: Send state digest, evidence summaries, and a questions object whose entries are type=choice with closed criteria. Accept only a returned choice present in the supplied criteria plus confidence/probabilities.
runtimeProposal.deadlineBasis: inferred from local receipts: 41 measured calls, p50 1509ms, p95 2338ms, max 2691ms; existing Jev dispatch also specified a <=3s budget
runtimeProposal.fallback: On timeout, transport error, invalid JSON, unknown choice, or stale state digest, record advisory_unavailable and show the unchanged deterministic eligible set. Do not auto-select.
runtimeProposal.replay: Persist input hash, exact eligible IDs, model ID, response bytes/hash, latency, deadline/fallback outcome, and accepted root/player decision. Replay the recorded advisory; never call Jev again for an existing event sequence.

actualLocalJevEvidence.finding: typesafe-ai/jev accepted closed type=choice criteria and returned choice, confidence, and probabilities; result authority was explicitly 0.

implementationSequence: Define the typed event and graph JSON schema using existing IDs, receipt keys, sequence, simTick, state digest, and evidence refs.
Emit one append-only event at player choice, receipt, task ACK, accepted physics result, observed delta, transition, and eligibility recomputation.
Project the current state and choice graph from events; never let the view mutate authority.
Render Korean choice nodes and evidence edges from that projection.
Add deterministic replay from origin for one fixed scenario and verify event/state digests.
Run Jev typed review on the frozen graph artifact; keep any realtime call behind an optional advisory flag.
deferred: Exact mid-run fork before complete checkpoint
Scientific causal identification from one gameplay trace
Jev-generated code or autonomous runtime decisions
stopCondition: Stop this research lane after the JSON graph parses and root receives the recommendation; Unity implementation and Jev invocation remain separate owner decisions.
